svg.title: C22-M02-F2: Authentication strength ladder
svg.desc: A ladder from password to FIDO2 with numeric strengths used by the lab policy, noting that restricted resources need the top level.
svg.text: password (1) < SMS/voice < TOTP (2) < push+number match (2) < FIDO2/passkey (3)
restricted resources require 3 (lab policy); medium risk adds +1
Figure C22-M02-F2. Relative phishing resistance and the lab policy's strength values.
